Attachments: INV-2026-88.pdf (invoice)

If you can reply with preferred payment path and any bank/PO details, I’ll coordinate the routing team.

Looping in Finance ops and confirming a few internal points before we commit:

1) If ClearVista wires, we’ll accept but need the AP remit name to match the bank wire beneficiary exactly. Please confirm the beneficiary name in their PDF.
2) We can expedite issuance of a VAT attestation; however, issuance requires our tax team to validate QCT (quick company test) which could take 24 business hours.
